facts.text: Serve the mains when Darryl asks Sal what's for tea.
facts.why: The dinner scene has Darryl asking Sal what she calls the meal and her saying chicken, then 'Seasoning!'. He does not ask what's for tea.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Darryl asks Sal what it's called.
